_comment: Single source of truth for the packages whose change forces a LIVE /api/chat probe against the PR's Vercel preview (.github/workflows/ask-live-guard.yml). An entry is an exact package name, or a prefix ending in '*'. Derived from what /api/chat actually loads: lib/chatbot/embed.mjs dynamically imports @huggingface/transformers, which at runtime createRequire()s onnxruntime-node (invisible to Next's file tracer, see next.config.ts outputFileTracingIncludes and PR #255) and pulls onnxruntime-web, sharp and the @huggingface/* helpers; onnxruntime-node needs onnxruntime-common's CJS build; onnxruntime-web/-common bring flatbuffers, guid-typescript, long, protobufjs and @protobufjs/*; sharp's native binaries live in @img/*; `next` owns the file tracer itself; app/api/chat/route.ts uses @vercel/functions. Add a package here the moment /api/chat starts depending on it. Matching is by the last node_modules/<name> segment of every lockfile entry, so a lockfile-only (transitive) bump counts.
